title: The Voyager Golden Record
brief: A short documentary for an educational audience about the Voyager Golden Record: the 1977 launches of Voyager 1 and 2, the committee chaired by Carl Sagan that chose what to put on a gold-plated copper phonograph record, what is on it (greetings in 55 languages, sounds of Earth, music from around the world, 116 images), the diagram on its cover that tells a finder how to play it and where it came from, and why a message that may never be found still matters as Voyager 1 travels through interstellar space.
